newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria shares surge to intra-day high.
newsitem.headline: Austria shares surge to intra-day high.

text.p: Austrian shares surged to a historic intra-day high in midday trading on Monday, pushed higher by strong advances in market heavyweights VA Technologie, Flughafen Wien and Wienerberger.

The key ATX index breached the psychologically important 1,300 points mark, supported by positive leads from the German market and a stronger dollar. At 1010 GMT, the index was up 1.01 percent or 13 points at 1,303.70.
It was the first time the ATX had broken through 1,300. The index closed at 1,290.70 on Friday, and the previous intra-day high was 1,297.99 pts on May 21.
Market participants traced most of the buy orders to foreign investors, saying international players had taken a new interest in the Vienna market.
"The interest from abroad is really strong," said one.

However, traders were divided about the short-term outlook for the market, and most said the immediate direction would depend on fresh foreign leads expected later this week once U.S. and U.K. markets re-open on Tuesday.

Engineering group VA Technologie was up 3.41 percent at 2,182 schillings ($184), after hitting a new year high of 2,200 earlier in the day. Brick maker Wienerberger was up seven schillings at 2,482 after the stock went ex-dividend.

Airport operator Flughafen Wien rose 2.90 percent to 522.40 schillings. Traders said the share had strongly underperformed the market over recent months, adding the share was likely to show further advances over the next few days.
